seo_desc: Christmas events for kids in Fremont, Nebraska for 2026: 3 family events with dates, times and addresses checked on each host's page.
lede: Fremont starts Christmas with a downtown Christmas Walk, a tree lighting and Santa on Main Street, then a breakfast with Santa at the City Auditorium and a Jolly Jamboree at King of Kings Church.
celebrates: MainStreet of Fremont anchors the season with the 32nd annual Christmas Walk on Saturday, November 28, 2026, with a petting zoo, horse drawn wagon rides, letters to Santa and a 5:30 pm lighting of all 12 downtown trees, according to MainStreet's own page. The City of Fremont Parks and Recreation posts its Breakfast with Santa for December 12 at the City Auditorium.
lastyear: A radio station listing described the 30th Christmas Walk as held on Saturday, November 30, 2024, which makes this year's the 32nd by MainStreet's count. A 2025 listing for the City Auditorium breakfast called it a pancake feed from 9:30 am to 12:30 pm that was free for anyone to attend.
facts: MainStreet of Fremont says it is independent from the City of Fremont and is funded through sponsorships, donations, grants and fundraisers, according to the FAQ on its Christmas Walk page. The Fremont City Auditorium sits at 925 North Broad Street.
trains: We did not find a train ride in Fremont this Christmas. Our museum page for the Fremont and Elkhorn Valley Railroad says its excursions stopped in the 2010s, so do not plan around a holiday train there. The nearest train stop is the Durham Museum in Omaha's old Union Station, which our museum page covers.

faq: What is the biggest Christmas event in Fremont?
MainStreet of Fremont's Christmas Walk on Saturday, November 28, 2026, with horse drawn rides, a petting zoo and a tree lighting at 5:30 pm.
Can kids meet Santa in Fremont?
Yes. Santa is at Kiel's Barbershop from 6 to 8 pm on Christmas Walk day, and at the City Auditorium breakfast from 10 am on December 12.
Is there a Christmas train in Fremont?
We did not find one. The Fremont and Elkhorn Valley Railroad stopped excursions in the 2010s, according to our museum page.
The Breakfast with Santa and the Jolly Jamboree are indoors, while the Christmas Walk is mostly outdoors.
Prices are not printed for the 2026 events, so check with each host. A 2025 listing called the City Auditorium breakfast free.

intro_html:
Rally the corgi has sniffed out the best Christmas events for kids in Fremont for 2026, and here is what he found: 3 family events. The magic runs from November 28 (the 32nd annual Christmas Walk in downtown Fremont) through December 12 (Breakfast with Santa at the Fremont City Auditorium), with the Jolly Jamboree at King of Kings Church on December 11 in between. None of the three hosts prints a ticket price for 2026, so check with each host before you go. We check every date on the host's own page, and each listing links straight there.

What Rally found in Fremont

  • 3 Christmas events for kids in Fremont
  • Meet Santa: the Christmas Walk (6 to 8 pm at Kiel's Barbershop), the Jolly Jamboree and the City Auditorium breakfast (10 am)
  • No train ride: the Fremont and Elkhorn Valley Railroad has stopped excursions

Planning a bigger day out? Fremont families also use our guide to Christmas activities for kids in Omaha, which covers zoo lights, Santa visits and train rides across the metro.
